cited_by.title: Hair types 4a, 4b, 4c: what typing tells you

record.population: Review of hair classification, including the Walker system
record.finding: The Walker 1 to 4C system is described as the existing gold standard in practice but "relies upon qualitative classification measures, making the system vague and ambiguous".
record.note: From the 12 Nov baseline file; origin story of the system unverified.
